people.imagined: At the seat gate in late afternoon, standing guard with a long solemn face while a puppy chews his bootlace; he does not move because his captain is watching.
people.subject: The moment: standing rigid beside a great gate post at the hour the late sun turns gold, face solemn and eyes front, while a fat grey-and-white puppy gnaws at his bootlace far below. Face (most important: the long solemn face): a long, narrow, mournful, earnest face like a horse; sad, honest brown eyes; thick straight brows; a long straight nose; a long upper lip; a closed, serious mouth. Faint sunburn tints the long nose and a bead of sweat runs from his temple. Hair: brown, cropped short and bound in a small plain bronze-coloured cap-wrap. Body: tall, thin, upright, standing at attention with a rigid back. Clothing: the simplest graceful version of the sect's dress, a robe of plain bronze-grey silk with two crossed collars, the borders only faintly stitched with gold mountain ridges, narrow sleeves, a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star; his bootlaces are chewed to fuzz, one trailing on the ground. Hands and objects: a long spear with a bronze-tipped head held upright in both hands, knuckles pale; at his feet a plump shaggy puppy tugging the lace; a small tin cup hanging at his belt. Background: a blurred massive stone gate hung with silk banners of deep bronze and a lantern glowing amber in the haze. Light: warm gold evening light from the upper left, a thin silver mist along the ground and a soft rim of light on his shoulders. Expression: a long, solemn, helpless gravity, eyes front and mouth shut tight, a loyal sentry who dare not look down.

people.imagined: In the practice yard with a training spear, a jaw twitching when someone says the word peace. He laughed when a boy was gored in practice and called it footwork.
people.subject: The moment: in a practice yard at first light he leans on a training spear with one hip cocked, and his jaw twitches visibly as if someone had said a hated word. Face (most important: the twitching jaw): a lean, hard, hollow-cheeked young face; a muscle clearly bunched and jumping along the jaw hinge; narrow, cold dark eyes; thin black brows; a hooked nose; a thin sneering mouth. A thin pale scar nicks his upper lip. Hair: black, in a tight topknot held by a dark iron pin. Body: tall, lean, sinewy, a hard-trained spearman's build. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk under a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe, three crossed collars embroidered with gold mountain ridges, sleeves bound back to show cabled forearms; a black silk cord with seven knots and a small yellow jade tag at the waist; no star. Hands and objects: a long training spear with a blunt head and a grey tassel in the right hand, the left fist clenched on the hip; slung across his back past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain long straight sword, its grip bound in dark lace wound too thick, a plain disc guard, and a nicked grey wooden scabbard with a dented mouth. Power: a few faint motes of steel-grey metal qi drift off the spear's head. Background: a blurred practice yard of pale stone with shredded straw targets in a row. Light: cold silver dawn light from the upper left with a hard rim of light along the jaw. Expression: a cold, sneering, hungry stare with the jaw jumping, a man who wants the war more than anyone else in the yard and does not trouble to hide it.

people.imagined: At the mint filing blanks in a slow even rhythm, silver filings glinting in her eyelashes, taking a careful measured step across the floor. She counts the blanks a third time.
people.subject: The moment: at a filing bench in the mint she holds up a blank silver disc between finger and thumb and checks it against the light, silver dust sparkling on her lashes. Face (most important: silver filings in the eyelashes): a calm, carefully composed, oval face; honest grey eyes with a fringe of eyelashes sparkling with fine silver dust, clearly glinting; neat level brows; a straight nose; a small tidy mouth. Hair: black, parted and pinned in a low bun with a slim silver hairpin. Body: slender, upright, controlled, an even measured way of standing. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with a pale grey gauze over-robe, two crossed collars edged with thin gold mountain ridges, wide sleeves caught back by silver clasps; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a yellow jade tag; no star. Hands and objects: a thin silver disc held up in the right hand; a flat steel file in the left; on the bench three stacks of blank discs and a small brass counting dish; silver filings lying in a thin glittering layer along the bench edge. Power: a few pale steel-grey motes of metal qi float up and wink among the filings. Background: a blurred mint workshop with a dull furnace glow behind a gauze of pale smoke and the shape of a second worker. Light: cool silver light from the upper left with bright glints, a soft rim of light on her cheek. Expression: a careful, measuring squint with silver dust on her lashes and a small honest frown of concentration.

people.imagined: Back at the mine shaft after passing the beam and being sent home, he sits on a ward-stone with a curved back and a serene look, entirely unbothered.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a squat grey ward-stone at the mouth of a mine in the pearly light of early morning, his back deeply curved, he looks up with a serene, unhurried look, entirely unbothered. Face: a broad, placid, brown young face; calm, slow dark eyes; thick relaxed brows; a flat wide nose; a gentle half-smile; a dusting of black iron grit on the cheek and fine black dust in his eyelashes. Hair: black, short, plain, bound with a thin bronze band. Body: broad, thick through the back, with a pronounced curve of the spine from mine work, hands resting on the knees. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk, its hem and cuffs dusted black with iron grit but the silk itself clean and fine, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, wide sleeves; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star; plain dark boots. Hands and objects: a small hammer and a flat grey ward-stone with a faint cut ring pattern beside him; the right hand holds a lantern of pale glass with a calm flame; the left lies on his knee. The wick burns steady. Power: a few drifting motes of steel-grey metal qi catch the lantern glow. Background: a blurred mine entrance with timber props and rails and a cart carrying a single black ingot, mist curling out of the dark. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left and cold blue dawn light from the upper left, a soft glow on the ingot. Expression: a serene, slow, placid half-smile, the unbothered calm of a man who was sent home and is entirely at home where he was sent.

people.imagined: On the night of the new moon she scrubs the soot from an array node, a pilgrim's bead string running through her thumbs as she works, her palms grey. She is learning the order of the seven.
people.subject: The moment: on the night of the new moon she kneels beside a low round bronze node plate and scrubs it with a stiff brush, a string of dark wooden prayer beads looped round her left thumb clicking over as she works. Face: a calm, pale, oval face; downcast steady dark eyes; fine level brows; a straight nose; a small peaceful mouth; a smear of soot on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long single braid pinned up in a round coil with a small gold pin, a few wisps loose. Body: slim, kneeling very straight, her wide sleeves tied back with silk cords. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk under a soft iron-grey gauze over-robe, three crossed collars embroidered with the seven Dipper stars in gold, cuffs dusted soot-grey; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star. Hands and objects (the grey palms must read): both palms and fingers are stained soot-grey, a dull dark grey like pencil lead, clearly visible; a pilgrim's bead string of dark wood in the left hand; the stiff brush in the right and a pail of water; the round bronze plate with a faintly raised ring pattern. Power: where she touches the plate, a few faint ochre motes of earth qi rise like dust in sunlight. Background: a dim array chamber with six other bronze plates in a curved row, each with a small steady flame hanging above it in the haze. Light: soft candlelight from the lower left and a pale spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim of light on her braid. Expression: a calm, devout face with lowered eyes on the plate and a quiet, patient mouth, the beads clicking at her thumb.

people.imagined: In the guardhouse he has checked the wall behind him before sitting, and sits now with his eyes on the door, thumbnails cracked from digging snow-jade. He suspects the evening watch is worse than grief.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a bench in a stone guardhouse with his back pressed against the wall, he watches the doorway with narrowed eyes, one hand resting on the hilt of a short sword. Face: a lean, pale, drawn face; restless dark eyes ringed with shadow, constantly watching; thin straight brows; a sharp nose; a thin tight mouth; a few days of dark stubble. Hair: black, tied in a short knot with a plain bronze pin, sweat-damp. Body: wiry, tense, sitting upright on the front edge of the bench with his feet planted ready to rise. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, sleeves bound close at the wrist for the cold, a fine fur-trimmed collar of pale grey; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star. Hands and objects (the thumbnails must read): the thumbnails on both hands are cracked, split and ridged, with dark grime in the splits, clearly visible; the right hand on the hilt of a short sword in a plain scabbard; a lit lantern on the bench. Power: a thin shiver of steel-grey metal qi runs along the scabbard. Background: a blurred guardhouse of dark stone with a barred window showing falling snow and a pale mist at the sill. Light: low warm lantern light from the left and cold moonlit blue through the window, a thin rim of light along the cheek. Expression: narrowed, watchful eyes fixed on the doorway, a tight jaw and a mouth held in a hard line.

people.imagined: At the copying desk with cramped shoulders, a hair-ribbon the colour of pine soot, forming a careful stroke. She has been told never to ask for the Chiết Kích shelf and does not know why.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a copying desk with her shoulders drawn up in a cramped hunch she forms a careful brush stroke on a sheet, tongue between her teeth, then glances up. Face: a plain, earnest, round young face; mild brown eyes; soft level brows; a small nose; her tongue tip between her teeth in concentration; a tiny ink dot on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with a ribbon of silk the colour of pine soot, matt black-green, clearly visible. Body: small, cramped round-shouldered copyist's frame, shoulders raised nearly to her ears. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with a soft grey gauze over-robe, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, wide sleeves tied back, the cuffs stained with black ink; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star. Hands and objects: a thin brush in the right hand and a small stone ink-slab with fresh black ink; a half-copied sheet of ruled columns of tick marks, no letters; a model sheet pinned above; a small jar of village-made ink with a plain cork. Power: a few faint steel-grey motes of metal qi drift from the wet brush tip. Background: a blurred archive copying room with tall shelves and a narrow window, pale mist in the beams. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left and a warm lamp glow on the page, a gentle rim of light on her hair. Expression: an innocent, earnest face with the tongue between her teeth and wide, trusting eyes, shy under the cramped shoulders.

people.imagined: At the standard scales, fingers hovering over a weight as if reading it, chin cocked, declaring that someone's weights are light, louder than he should. He has chosen a merchant to dislike today.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a weighing counter he holds one hand hovering above a small bronze weight as if reading it with the skin, chin tilted cockily up, and looks at the viewer with arrogant certainty. Face: a sharp-featured, handsome young face; confident dark eyes; thick arched brows; a straight nose; a smug smile on a stubborn mouth; a narrow chin held high. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat knot with a carved pin of pale jade. Body: lean, upright, a swaggering lean back, shoulders thrown wide. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk, beautifully cut, with a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe, three crossed collars embroidered with gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves, the cuffs fastened with small gold buttons; a black silk cord with seven knots and a yellow jade tag at the waist; no star. Hands and objects (the hovering fingers must read): the long fingers of the right hand are spread and hover a finger-width above the weight, not touching it, clearly poised; on the counter a row of small bronze weights and a brass balance; the left hand points accusingly at one of the pans. Power: a faint steel-grey shimmer of metal qi gathers in the air under his spread fingers. Background: a blurred market stall with merchants' baskets and a pill-stall awning in the distance, softened by a silver haze. Light: bright pearly light from the upper left with glints on the bronze and a crisp rim of light along his chin. Expression: a cocky, self-assured smirk with the chin tilted up and half-lidded eyes that have already decided.

people.imagined: At the quarry she swings a mallet, one arm bulged with muscle, rock-flour in her hair, impatient to plant a stele on the border instead of cutting it. She looks up, daring someone to tell her to wait.
people.subject: The moment: at a quarry face she swings a heavy iron mallet over her shoulder mid-blow, her whole body twisted into the stroke, and glares at the viewer with a challenge. Face: a strong, broad, freckled, determined face; bright hazel eyes narrowed; thick straight brows; a snub nose; a stubborn, set jaw and a tight mouth. Hair: brown, tied in a thick tail and powdered pale grey with rock-flour so it looks dusted with ash, clearly visible. Body: tough, stocky, one forearm visibly bulged from the mallet, broad back. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with the wide sleeves cut and tied short at the elbow, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, the whole robe heavily dusted with pale stone powder; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star; slim leather wrist-guards. Hands and objects: a heavy iron mallet in the right hand; a steel wedge held in the left against the stone; behind her a stack of rough-cut slabs; chips of grey stone hanging in the air. Power: ochre motes of earth qi swirl up with the stone dust at each blow. Background: a blurred open quarry with a pale, sheer cliff and a derrick, a white haze rolling off the stone. Light: bright silvery light from the upper left, the dust glowing like mist and a hard rim of light on her shoulder. Expression: a hard, impatient glare with a jutting jaw and blazing eyes, brows low, a flush of effort on the cheeks.

people.imagined: In the open square at Song Kiều he rubs an ore sample on the touchstone and shouts the grade, his voice cracking. Thin scars of silver thread cross his fingertips.
people.subject: The moment: in an open square he rubs a lump of ore across a black touchstone held in his left hand and calls out a grade, mouth wide, his voice visibly cracking. Face: a thin, honest, eager young face; bright brown eyes wide with effort; thin straight brows; a pointed nose; an open mouth shouting, the throat bobbing; a few pimples on the chin. Hair: black, short and spiky, a strip of bronze silk tied round the brow. Body: thin, gangly, adolescent, a prominent Adam's apple. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with the wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, a pale grey gauze sash over the shoulder; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star. Hands and objects (the scars must read): the fingertips of both hands are crossed with many fine pale thread-like scars, shining faintly silver, clearly visible; the black touchstone with a bright streak of silver rubbed on it; a lump of grey ore in the right hand; a basket of ore at his feet. Power: a thin spark of steel-grey metal qi flickers where ore meets stone. Background: a blurred open square with miners, carts, brass scales and an old merchant listening closely, a pearly morning mist over it all. Light: bright clear light from the upper left with a soft glow on the silver streak and a rim of light on his hair. Expression: an open mouth mid-shout and bright, earnest eyes, the throat straining and the cheeks flushed.

people.imagined: In the seat kitchen at the height of the noon rush, she jabs her ladle like a spear at a steward who has come to count the stores. She has been shouting for forty years and enjoys it.
people.subject: The moment: in a steaming kitchen at the height of the noon rush she thrusts a long iron ladle forward like a spear, pointed straight at the viewer, her mouth open mid-shout. Face: a broad, ruddy, strong-featured woman's face, shiny with heat; blazing dark eyes; thick straight brows drawn down; a short broad nose; a wide mouth open in a shout, strong square teeth; a sheen of sweat. Hair: black going grey, tied in a thick knot under a clean white silk cloth. Body: short, broad, powerful, a cook's strong shoulders and round middle, planted wide. Clothing: a servant's dress kept plain but clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and short sleeves, a pale gold thread along the hem, a clean long white apron over it; no cord and no star. Hands and objects (the scald must read): her LEFT forearm, bared to the elbow, carries a broad shiny pink-red scald scar, glossy and puckered, plainly visible beside the ladle; the long iron ladle gripped in her right hand; behind her a great black iron pot steaming, mutton joints hanging, and strings of dried barley sheaves. Background: a blurred busy kitchen with a hearth fire, copper pots and thick drifting steam. Light: strong orange firelight from the lower left, steam glowing like mist and a warm rim of light on her damp cheek. Expression: a fierce, roaring open mouth with flaring nostrils and glittering eyes, delighted by her own noise.

people.imagined: At dusk in the clock-house, he stands perfectly still beside the water clock with the bell-rope in his hand, waiting the last drop before the one stroke. The clock-hands seem nervous beside him.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk he stands utterly still beside a stone water-clock, one hand on a bell-rope, eyes fixed on a single falling drop. Face (most important: the stillness): a smooth, long, calm face with no tension anywhere; deep-set steady brown eyes that do not blink; level brows; a straight nose; a closed, peaceful mouth; a face like still water. Hair: black, short, tied with a plain cord of pale silk. Body: tall, lean, balanced, without motion; long patient forearms hanging relaxed. Clothing: a servant's dress kept simple and immaculate, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and a thin gold edge, sleeves rolled to show long forearms, a pale grey gauze scarf at the neck; no cord and no star. Hands and objects: the right hand lightly on a thick bell-rope that rises out of frame to a single bronze bell; before him a tall stone water-clock of stepped basins, one drop of water hanging from a spout; a small bronze marker on a rail. Power: a faint blue sheen of water qi rises from the basins in slow wisps, like breath on cold glass. Background: a blurred round clock-house with a dim bronze bell above and the last gold light in a window. Light: soft, low, golden dusk light from the upper left on the water, pale mist above the basins and a gentle rim of light on his cheek. Expression: a very still, quiet face with unblinking eyes fixed on the falling drop and a calm, reverent mouth.

people.imagined: In the archive's ink room, he has licked the grinding stone again and his lips are blue. He edges sideways along a shelf with a feather duster, shy, and looks up when the copyist points.
people.subject: The moment: shuffling sideways along a shelf with a feather duster in one hand, he glances shyly at the viewer, lips stained blue. Face (most important: the ink-blue lips): a soft, plain, boyish face; both lips stained a vivid dark ink-blue, as if painted, clearly visible; shy, round, brown eyes; thin soft brows; a short snub nose; a small timid smile; blue on the tongue tip. His ears are pink with embarrassment. Hair: black, cut short, a cowlick at the back. Body: slight, narrow-shouldered, a shy crabwise sideways gait with the shoulder pointed ahead. Clothing: a servant's dress kept plain and clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar, short sleeves and a faint gold edging, a pale grey silk sash; no cord and no star; the cuffs and fingertips are stained blue-black with ink. Hands and objects: a long feather duster in the right hand; the left carrying a flat grey grinding stone with a small cake of black ink and a damp cloth; a stool with a bucket. Power: a few ochre motes of earth qi turn slowly in the dust he stirs. Background: blurred tall shelves of identical lacquered boxes climbing into shadow, a single lamp throwing warm light on their curved edges, a fine mist of dust in the air. Light: soft warm lamplight from the upper left, a silvery glow among the motes and a light rim on his hair. Expression: a shy, timid, blue-lipped smile with round eyes cast sideways, an anxious boy hoping he is dusting the right shelf.

people.imagined: In the little cord room she ties the seventh knot in a black cord with perfectly practised fingers, and smiles the half-smile of someone who already knows who passed. She does not look at the viewer; she looks at the cord.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a small table in a quiet cord room she draws the seventh knot tight on a black silk cord, her eyes on her fingers and a knowing half-smile playing at her mouth. Face: a smooth, round, serene face; downcast dark eyes with a glint beneath the lids; neat thin brows; a small nose; a closed half-smile with one corner lifted, the look of a person who knows. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a scrap of felt-white cloth tied round it. Body: small, sturdy, composed. Clothing: a servant's dress kept plain and clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and a thin gold edge, sleeves tied back, a little white felt fuzz clinging to the cuffs; no cord and no star herself. Hands and objects (the fingertips must read): the fingertips of both hands are hardened into glossy yellow calluses, shown clearly as she draws the knot; a black cord with six tight knots and the seventh forming; on the table a row of identical black cords coiled in a neat line, and a small bowl of wax. Power: a faint ochre shimmer of earth qi lingers on the finished knots like warm dust. Background: a blurred small room with shelves of folded bronze-grey robes and a narrow window, a pale mist at the glass. Light: soft silvery daylight from the upper left, a warm gleam on the cords and a gentle rim of light on her cheek. Expression: a knowing half-smile with lowered lids and a calm, content brow, eyes on her fingers.

people.imagined: On the Thạch Kiều road, bowed forward under a tall stack of lacquered case boxes, the strap across his forehead. He walks as he has walked for years, calm, content, and nobody else is trusted with the sealed ones.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a mountain road bent permanently forward under a huge stack of lacquered case boxes lashed to a wooden frame on his back, a broad strap across his forehead, his eyes lifted to meet the viewer's. Face (most important: the forehead groove): a broad, plain, calm, tanned face; a deep dented groove across the forehead, red and polished, where the tump-line rides, clearly visible; mild dark eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; a placid closed mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and damp, under a small straw cap pushed back. Body: stocky, immensely strong in the neck and legs, the back bowed in a permanent bow even when empty. Clothing: a porter's dress kept plain and clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and a thin gold edge, sleeves rolled and tied, short trousers wrapped at the calves, simple straw sandals; no cord and no star. Hands and objects: both hands gripping the straps at his chest; on his back a tall frame stacked with a dozen identical dark lacquered boxes, the top few bound with red silk cord and plain blank wax seals. Power: a thin ochre haze of earth qi gathers at his feet with each step, as though the road itself carried him. Background: a blurred stone road and pines in a soft silver mist. Light: soft pearly afternoon light from the upper left, a faint golden glow on the lacquer and a light rim on his shoulder. Expression: a calm, easy face under the strap with a quiet contented set to the mouth and steady, unhurried eyes.

people.imagined: Sweeping the Bridge Court steps in the cold morning with a broom taller than she is, bare, chapped ankles in the frost, chattering to the regulars on the steps by name. She is also counting who came.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping long stone steps with a broom much taller than herself, she pauses and looks up with a bright, brisk, knowing smile at the viewer, as at a regular. Face: a small, sharp, pretty, street-bred face; lively dark eyes with a calculating sparkle; thin arched brows; a small upturned nose; a ready, cheerful, empty smile; chapped red cheeks. Hair: black, in two short tight braids tied with red silk thread, a few strands loose. Body: small, thin, quick, standing straight like a young soldier. Clothing: a servant's dress kept plain and clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and short sleeves, belted with a pale silk sash, a short shawl of pale grey wool around her shoulders; old cloth shoes on feet with the bare ankles above them red and chapped, plainly visible; no cord and no star. Hands and objects: a very tall birch-twig broom held in both hands, its top above her head; on the steps behind her a scattering of small figures sitting listening, a few leaves and a bit of straw. Power: a few warm motes of fire qi float up from her breath in the cold. Background: the wide stone steps of the Bridge Court with pillars and a crowd of onlookers in winter coats, a pale mist lying low on the stone. Light: cold bright morning light from the upper left, a silver glow on the frost and a thin rim of light on her braids. Expression: a bright, brisk smile with sparkling eyes that flick over each face, warm on the surface and quick behind it.

people.imagined: In the crane loft at the seat he is whistling softly through his teeth and checking a tall crane's wing, a feather tucked in his collar. He knows each bird by a single feather.
people.subject: The moment: in a high loft he runs a gentle hand along the long folded wing of a tall white crane while whistling softly through his teeth, looking up with a mild smile. Face: a gentle, plain, sunburnt face; mild brown eyes; soft thin brows; a straight nose; lips pursed round a quiet whistle; a gap in the front teeth. Hair: black, in a loose knot, a long white crane feather tucked in his collar and another behind his ear. Body: lanky, slow, quiet, a patient stoop. Clothing: a servant's dress kept plain and clean, a tunic of soft bronze-grey cloth with a crossed collar and short sleeves, the cuffs dusted with feather down, a pale grey silk belt with a small pouch of grain; a pair of leather gauntlets tucked in; no cord and no star. Hands and objects: the right hand smoothing the crane's wing; the left holding a small bucket of fish scraps; the tall white crane with black wingtips and a red crown standing beside him with its long neck curved toward his shoulder; a small pale feather in his palm. Power: a few soft green motes of wood qi drift between the man and the bird like pollen. Background: a blurred wooden crane loft with perches, hanging nets and a wide window of sky lit with drifting cloud. Light: soft bright spirit-light from the upper left, mist at the window and a delicate rim of light on the crane's feathers. Expression: a faint contented whistle on pursed lips, the gaze tender toward the crane.

people.imagined: Late at night in the head's court, he has set down his go stone and looks up at the viewer; the stone seal rests at his chest on its cord. He looks fifty and slightly tired, and the inked middle finger of his right hand has just smoothed a page.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a go board late at night in the head's court, he lifts his eyes from a white stone held between two fingers to look steadily at the viewer, the grey stone seal swinging on its cord at his chest. Face: a narrow, quiet, slightly tired, clever face; fine lines at the eyes; calm, grey, accountant's eyes with a hint of shadow beneath; thin level brows; a straight narrow nose; a thin, closed, patient mouth; a short, neat grey beard along the jaw. Hair: dark grey, combed back and gathered in a flat knot beneath a small gold-bronze crown. Body: slim, narrow, straight-backed, seated with perfect economy. Clothing: the sect's richest dress: a black silk outer robe with a high collar over a flowing under-robe of deep bronze and earth-gold brocade, three crossed collars embroidered with gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves; a broad sash with a heavy yellow jade seal; a black silk cord with seven knots and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: the right middle finger is stained black with ink to the first joint, held out clearly as it grips the stone; a palm-sized square grey stone seal on a cord at his chest, cut with a pole and seven small dots; a go board with scattered stones. Power: slow wisps of ochre earth qi and steel-grey metal qi coil around his sleeves and settle over the board like a quiet fog. Background: a blurred dim court with a lamp. Light: warm low lamplight from the lower left, a pale spirit-glow from the seal and a soft rim of light on his shoulders. Expression: a slow, tired, level gaze with the faintest watchful lift at the corner of the mouth, calm as a stone.

people.imagined: At the Bridge Court bench, she has begun to speak and speaks so quietly that the court itself carries her voice. Her fist closes on the black Weight. Her unfinished judgement lies before her.
people.subject: The moment: seated on the bench of the Bridge Court she speaks in a quiet voice, lips barely moving, one small hand closed around a black fist-sized stone on the bench before her. Face: a small, square-jawed, composed face; steady dark eyes that read like a balance beam; level straight brows; a short straight nose; a narrow, firm, quiet mouth; a few fine lines. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a smooth low knot beneath a tall crown of dark iron and gold, a plain iron pin through it. Body: small, square-shouldered, upright and still, a judge's absolute stillness. Clothing: the sect's richest dress as worn on the bench: a black silk outer robe with a high collar, seven arches woven in the same black at the hem, over bronze and earth-gold brocade layers with three crossed collars edged in gold mountain ridges, wide sleeves whose cuffs are darker where hands have rested; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar; at her chest a pale grey stone pendant, cold-looking. Hands and objects: the right hand closed on a black stone the size of a fist, the Weight, resting on a small wooden stand; a blank rolled scroll beside it. Power: a heavy stillness of ochre earth qi gathers around the Weight with a faint ring of steel-grey motes hanging level above it. Background: a blurred high stone court with pillars and rows of silent listeners on steps beyond an arch. Light: cool even spirit-light from the upper left with a pale glow from the pendant and a thin rim of light on her crown. Expression: a quiet, steady face with lips barely moving, firm, unbending eyes and a calm stubborn set to the chin.

people.imagined: At the edge of the war-writ office he stands at the margin of the room as he always does, hands behind his back, looking at the iron-hooped drum that hangs behind his chair and thinking of the marshal's banner.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the margin of the war-writ office as he always does, he looks past the viewer toward a big iron-hooped drum hanging on the wall, jaw set, hands clasped behind his back. Face: a square, hard, sunburnt face with a heavy jaw; keen pale-brown hawk's eyes under thick straight brows; a strong, sharp, slightly hooked nose; a firm, honest, thin mouth; sun-lines at the eyes; stubble of white. Hair: grey, cropped short like a brush, standing straight, a narrow bronze circlet across the brow. Body: broad, square, tall, a soldier's weight and stillness, standing to one side and a little forward as a man who stays near the door. Clothing: the sect's rich elder dress cut for a warrior: a black silk outer robe with a high collar, tight sleeves, over deep bronze and earth-gold brocade layers embroidered at the borders with gold Dipper stars, a dark grey lacquered harness across the chest; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands clasped behind his back; propped near him a plain spear with seven notches cut in the shaft; on the wall behind, a big drum hooped with black iron and skinned with ox hide. Power: a cold steel-grey haze of metal qi rolls off his shoulders and lies along the floor like frost. Background: a blurred war-office wall with maps in plain coloured shapes and a rack of spears. Light: hard pale spirit-light from the upper left, a glint along the drum's iron hoops and a sharp rim of light on his jaw. Expression: a set jaw and a hard, distant stare with lips pressed flat, the face of a man waiting for his war.

people.imagined: In a courteous audience he smiles a dry, handsome smile, white jade tally hung at his hip where a sword would be and an iron fan folded harmless in his hand. He is thinking of a peace that will end the counting.
people.subject: The moment: in a courteous audience he inclines his head with a dry, polished, handsome smile and taps a closed iron fan lightly against his palm. Face: a long-faced, handsome, dry man; fine regular features; bright, shrewd dark eyes; level, arched brows; a long, straight nose; a thin, elegant, slightly superior mouth; a neat black pointed beard. Hair: black, glossy, in a high knot held by a small gold-bronze crown with a fine iron pin and a single jade bead. Body: tall, slim, easy, a diplomat's relaxed upright carriage. Clothing: a robe a shade finer than the seat allows, as an envoy's richest dress: layered court silk of deep bronze and earth-gold with a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe that shimmers, three crossed collars embroidered in gold with Dipper stars and mountain ridges, wide sleeves; a broad sash; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: at the hip, where a sword would hang, a white jade half-tally on a grey cord, plainly visible; a closed iron fan with dull steel ribs in the right hand; a small pale-green teacup in the left. Power: a faint steel-grey shimmer of metal qi plays along the fan's ribs and a thin trace of it curls from the teacup like steam. Background: a blurred courteous reception hall with a painted screen and a window of pale light. Light: warm moonlit light from the upper left, a gleam on the jade and a soft rim of light along his sleeve. Expression: a dry, polished smile with the head inclined and cool, calculating eyes behind the courtesy.

people.imagined: In the archive, frail and bent, with black ink to the wrists and her hand on the keys on their cord around her neck. She touches them when she speaks, and is thinking of a missing half of a tally.
people.subject: The moment: standing bent over a cane among tall archive shelves, an extremely old woman raises a hand to touch the keys at her throat while looking sharply at the viewer. Face: a very old, very thin, deeply wrinkled face like folded paper; clever, sharp, black eyes bright in hollows; thin white brows; a sharp small nose; thin pale lips pressed; hollow cheeks. Hair: sparse snow-white hair in a tiny tight bun with an iron pin and a narrow bronze band. Body: tiny, bent nearly double, frail, thin as a bird, leaning on a stick. Clothing: the sect's elder dress in its quietest form: a black silk outer robe with a high collar over layers of dust-grey and bronze silk, reinforced at the elbows with neat panels of matching grey since she is always leaning on shelves, long wide sleeves; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects (the black wrists must read): both hands and wrists are black with ink to the wrist, as if gloved in black, plainly visible; at her neck on a cord a bronze key on a jade bead, touched by two black fingers; a cane of dark wood. Power: a slow tide of steel-grey metal qi and ochre earth qi pools about her feet, still as dust. Background: blurred towering archive shelves of lacquered boxes, a single lamp hanging from a hook and long ladders leaning against the shelves. Light: low warm lamplight from the upper left, dust motes glowing like tiny stars. Expression: a sharp, guarded, unwavering stare with the thin lips pressed, a frail old woman who guards every shelf and counts every key.

people.imagined: Steward of the seat, walking the long corridor with a rolling gait as if on a deck, ledger strings at his sleeve, a straight blade hanging point-down at his back. He has wanted the Seal for a century and has stopped being ashamed.
people.subject: The moment: striding along a long corridor with a slight rolling sailor's gait, he turns his broad head to the viewer with a steady, assessing look. Face: a broad, weathered, strong face tanned by harbour winds; narrow keen grey eyes under heavy straight brows; a wide, flat-bridged nose; a firm, wide, thin-lipped mouth; short clipped iron-grey stubble and a short grey beard. Hair: iron grey, tied in a knot beneath a small bronze crown with an iron pin. Body: broad, thick-shouldered, heavy and well balanced, walking with weight low like a man on a rolling deck. Clothing: the sect's rich steward's dress: deep bronze and earth-gold silk under a black silk outer robe with a high collar, immaculate, three crossed collars embroidered in gold with Dipper stars, wide sleeves; ledger strings, thin grey cords with tiny wooden tally beads, hanging at the right sleeve; a broad sash; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar. Hands and objects: on his back, hanging point-down from a strap, a narrow perfectly straight sword like a plumb line, its pommel showing over the shoulder; at the belt a small jade-cased level; the right hand carrying a bound ledger with a plain cover. Power: faint steel-grey wisps of metal qi trail from the sword's hanging point and ripple the hem of his robe. Background: a blurred long stone corridor with pillars and a distant lamp, mist drifting between the columns. Light: cool silver light from the upper left, a gleam on the jade level and a firm rim of light along his shoulder. Expression: a steady, assessing look with a broad face set hard, the mouth firm and the eyes shameless in their wanting.

people.imagined: First on the training floor at dawn and the last to leave; she has caught the first sunlight on her short gold-tinted sword and is looking back at the viewer, quick and sure, her hair tied up with a gold cord.
people.subject: The moment: on a wide training floor at first light she stands in a fresh sword stance, a short gold-tinted blade raised catching the sun, glancing quickly at the viewer. Face: a tall, strong, quick, sun-browned woman's face; bright, bold, dark brown eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm, confident, slightly smiling mouth; a fine sheen of sweat. Hair: black, tied up high in a tail bound with a thin gold cord and a small gold-bronze hair crown, a few strands stuck to her temples. Body: tall, long-limbed, athletic, quick in the stance, shoulders squared. Clothing: a close-cut version of the sect's richer dress for a named heir: bronze and earth-gold silk with tight sleeves bound at the wrist for movement, a dark iron-grey gauze over-robe streaming behind her, crossed collars with a gold-thread edge embroidered with Dipper stars; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a short grey wrap. Hands and objects: a short, gold-tinted flying sword with a plain grip held in the right hand, the blade catching the dawn; in the left hand a small plain flag of pale silk on a short staff, planted behind her second; the ink stain on her middle finger. Power: a ribbon of steel-grey metal qi winds up the blade and sheds bright sparks, clearer than any low-realm disciple could show. Background: a blurred wide stone training floor, a pale dawn sky and a few figures at the far end. Light: warm gold first light from the upper left catching the blade, thin morning mist and a bright rim of light on her cheek. Expression: a quick, sure glance with bright eyes and a determined set to the mouth, sunlight on her cheek.

people.imagined: Across a table she is reading the other person's handwriting upside down, thin and freckled, soot-grey at the fingertips. She has the face of someone who has given a document away and cannot take it back.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a table she leans forward and reads, upside down, a document placed before the viewer, her head tilted, eyes sharp and level. Face: a thin, freckled, honest face; clear grey-green eyes quick and attentive; straight thin brows; a narrow nose crowded with freckles; a firm thin mouth; a faint line of worry between the brows. Hair: reddish-brown, in a simple low plait pinned up with a gold pin, a few strands loose. Body: thin, narrow, shoulders drawn in, leaning over the table. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of bronze-gold silk with a soft iron-grey gauze over-robe, two crossed collars edged with gold mountain ridges, long wide sleeves stained with ink and tinted soot-grey at the cuffs; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and no star. Hands and objects (the fingertips must read): the fingertips of both hands are soot-grey, a dull charcoal colour; a small round soapstone seal with a plain carved pattern in the right hand; before her a sheet of paper with only faint ruled lines, seen upside down; a brush laid across an ink slab. Power: a thin steel-grey thread of metal qi leaks from her fingertips and trembles over the page. Background: a blurred archive copying room with shelves of lacquered boxes, a pale mist near the ceiling. Light: soft silvery spirit-light from the upper left and a warm lamp glow, a faint rim of light on her plait. Expression: sharp, level eyes with a thin, tense mouth and the haunted look of someone who has given something away.

people.imagined: The founder at eighty arriving on the Thiên Tuyền plateau under the Dipper, laughing, a drinking gourd in his hand, a hermit's foundling who won mountains by fair weights. He has just sat to drink with an old friend.
people.subject: The moment: the founder at eighty, seated on a mountain rock beneath a night sky, laughs heartily with a drinking gourd raised; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, open, weathered face lined with laughter; a long thick white beard to the chest; bright, merry, dark eyes crinkled with laughter; thick white brows; a big nose; a wide open mouth, white teeth. Deep laugh lines run from his eyes to his temples. Hair: long white hair, loose and wild, bound at the brow with a plain cord and a single gold-bronze ring. Body: tall, broad, lean, a hardy hermit's build, one knee up. Clothing: an immortal's robe in an early, simple form of the sect's dress: flowing layers of bronze and earth-gold silk under a wide grey gauze outer robe, two crossed collars embroidered with the first faint Dipper stars in gold, long wide sleeves lifting in the wind; a rope belt hung with a small bronze balance and a yellow jade bead. Hands and objects: a big round drinking gourd raised in the right hand; in the left a small round grey weight stone; a staff beside him; seven faint stars in a Dipper shape above his head. Power: a few pale golden motes drift from his sleeves toward the stars. Background: a faded dark blue-black night, a ridge, and the seven stars; a tiny red fire flickers at the foot of the rock and throws a faint glow on the gourd. Light: low silver starlight from the upper left with a faint warm firelight below, thin mist on the ridge. Expression: a big, open, merry laugh with crinkled eyes and white teeth, the easy warmth of a founder drinking with old friends under the stars.

people.imagined: The war marshal on the ramparts of Cố Lũy, the star-iron halberd planted beside him, a goatherd's son who has become the rampart. He looks out calmly at the army below, bright with loyalty.
people.subject: The moment: the war marshal stands on a rampart in full armour, plants a long halberd beside him and looks out over the viewer's shoulder with calm, burning loyalty; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, honest face; a black beard cropped square; steady dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a broken nose; a firm mouth. Hair: black, in a tight topknot under a plain iron helmet pushed back, with a few grey threads at his temples; the helmet's cheek-strap is knotted under his jaw. Body: huge, broad-shouldered, thick-armed, a goatherd's strength grown into a marshal's. Clothing: dark star-iron lamellar armour with grey silk-cord lacing and gold-edged shoulder plates, worn over a flowing robe of bronze and earth-gold silk with crossed collars embroidered with Dipper stars, a heavy grey cloak lined with silk thrown back in the wind; a broad belt with a yellow jade clasp. Hands and objects: a long halberd with a crescent blade of dark star iron, its haft taller than he is, planted at his side with the right hand; the left on the rampart wall. Power: a slow cold gleam of silver light runs along the halberd's crescent and a few pale motes drift from it like ash. Background: faded dusky ramparts with banners of plain dark silk and an army as small dark shapes below; above the wall a plain pole bears a limp dark banner and the sky is low and pale. Light: low pale spirit-light from the upper left, mist on the stones and a faint rim of light on the helmet. Expression: a calm face with burning, steady eyes and a firm, unsmiling mouth, set like the stone beneath him.

people.imagined: In the cave abode on the plain, after 147 years of hiding, he sits at the cave mouth with a furled banner across his knees, an old wound making him stiff. He does not move.
people.subject: The moment: in the dim mouth of a cave on the plain an old officer sits with a rolled banner across his knees, staring out stonily; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a gaunt, weathered, grim face; a long unkempt grey beard; deep-set, honest, dark eyes under heavy grey brows; a long nose; a hard, closed mouth; a pale scar down one cheek. His brows are thick and white at the ends and his hands show blue veins. Hair: long grey hair, tied back with a strip of dark silk. Body: lean, stiff, hard, sitting with one leg stretched straight out from an old wound. Clothing: a long dark grey officer's robe of heavy silk with a high collar and a crossed front, mended with meticulous stitches and clean, a faded bronze border along the hem, a plain sash; battered iron shoulder plates he has kept polished. Hands and objects: a rolled dark banner, tightly furled, with only a black shape visible, across his knees, both hands gripping it; a broken sabre hilt leaning against the rock; a small oil lamp at his foot. Power: a thin ghost of pale grey mist gathers at the cave mouth around him, drifting in from the grass. Background: a faded dark cave mouth with a pale slice of grassy plain beyond. Light: dim grey spirit-light from the upper left and a small yellow lamp glow. The faded silk tone turns everything to sepia, grey-green and muted rust. Expression: a stony, steady, silent endurance, the dark eyes unmoving and the mouth shut, an old soldier keeping faith with a lost cause.

people.imagined: The first Chief Judge, a scribe's daughter, seated at a plain desk with the freshly ground ink beside her and the first Weight in her hand, calm and humble, writing the wording of the Compact.
people.subject: The moment: the first Chief Judge sits at a plain desk and lifts a long brush and a black stone weight, glancing up with a calm, humble, attentive look; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a kind, composed, lined face; clear, quiet, dark eyes; level thin brows; a small straight nose; a gentle, firm mouth; a high smooth forehead. Faint ink smudges mark her right cheek where a hand has passed, and a tiny mole sits near the corner of her mouth. Hair: black with grey, in a smooth low coil pinned with two plain pins of pale wood and a thin gold-bronze band. Body: small, upright, still, a scholar's straight back. Clothing: an early form of the sect's elder robe: a long grey outer robe of fine silk with a high crossed collar and wide sleeves over layered bronze-gold silk, the hem plain, with only faint gold mountain ridges at the border; a simple silk cord belt hung with a small yellow jade. Hands and objects: a long brush in the right hand and a small fist-sized black stone weight in the left; a stone ink-slab worn into a hollow with fresh black ink; a long blank scroll unrolled across the desk. Power: a soft gold shimmer lingers over the wet brush tip like a breath of morning light. Background: a faded pale wall and a window with a pale sky. Light: soft low spirit-light from the upper left, a faint mist in the window and a gentle rim of light on her coil. Expression: just, patient, humble; ready to set down the first words, a grave, kind calm, as of someone about to write down a rule that will outlive her.

people.imagined: On the fort's stair at Phá Quân Môn, envoy's staff in his hand, he has delivered a refusal and is turning to go down; he is peaceable, brave, and does not know what the next step will cost. A poet by habit, he notices the light on the stone.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high stone stair with an envoy's staff held upright, he has just turned to descend and looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with a quiet, steady, slightly sad smile; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a lean, gentle, scholarly face; kind, clear, dark eyes with a hint of poetry in them; level thin brows; a straight nose; a calm, closed, peaceable mouth; a thin neat grey-black beard and moustache. Hair: black going grey, in a neat knot with a plain pin and a slim bronze crown-band. Body: slim, upright, tall, a diplomat's composed posture, unarmed, hands open. Clothing: an envoy's travelling dress in the sect's colours: flowing layers of bronze-gold silk under a grey gauze over-robe, three crossed collars embroidered with gold Dipper stars, wide sleeves lifting in the wind; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist and a small silver star at the collar; no sword and no iron anywhere on him. Hands and objects: a tall, plain envoy's wooden staff, topped with a plain wooden knob, held upright in the right hand; the left hand open, empty, palm out; a rolled letter, blank, tied with grey cord and tucked in his sleeve. Power: a faint gold-white shimmer follows the staff as if it still carried a last light. Background: a faded pale stone stair rising to a fort gate, a pale sky and a few distant dark shapes. Light: soft low pale spirit-light from the upper left and a thin rim of light on his shoulder. Expression: a quiet, calm look back over the shoulder with soft honest eyes and a peaceful mouth, the face of a man who carried only a refusal.

people.imagined: On the north rampart of Cố Lũy after five years of holding it, he stands steadfast beside his father's army, his small daughter far behind in a signal post. He is stubborn and loyal and turns to look back once.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a rampart in armour with his hand on a spear, he looks back toward the viewer with a stubborn, loyal, tired look; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a broad, rugged, strong face like his father's; a black beard clipped short; steady dark eyes under heavy straight brows; a broken nose; a firm, tight mouth; a pale scar crossing the left cheek. Deep lines mark his brow and the corners of his mouth. Hair: black, tied in a topknot under a plain iron helmet. Body: huge, broad, thick-armed, sturdy as the wall. Clothing: dark iron lamellar armour with grey silk-cord lacing and a gold-edged collar, over a flowing robe of bronze and earth-gold silk with crossed collars; a black silk cord with seven knots at the waist; a heavy grey silk-lined cloak. Hands and objects: a long spear with a dark iron head in the right hand, the butt on the stones; the left hand resting on a notched sabre hilt; a small carved wooden toy bird on a cord at his belt. Power: a few cold silver motes drift off the spear's head into the dusk. Background: faded dusky ramparts of a high fort and a pale sky with a dark banner. Light: low pale spirit-light from the upper left, a thread of mist along the wall and a faint rim of light on the helmet. The faded silk tone turns the whole scene to dusty rose, slate and ochre. Expression: a stubborn, tired, loyal look back over the shoulder with the jaw set, a man who holds the wall and thinks once of his daughter.
